title: Identity, Naming, Culture, Language, Demographic & Origin Construction
objective: Construct NPC/creature identity and origin layers from eligible owner-domain records while preserving proposal-versus-accepted truth, unresolved-safe behavior and support for nonhuman, unnamed and culturally distinct beings.

scope.purpose: Add bounded identity, naming, culture, language, demographic and origin construction over the MNCS-01 stable candidate/constraint core without taking canonical entity, World, culture, language or demographic authority.
scope.completion_gate: MNCS candidates can construct identity/origin layers from eligible governed references, including nonhuman/unnamed cases, while preserving unresolved facts, proposal/accepted distinctions and all owner-domain authority.

selection_boundaries: MNCS-04 completed identity/origin proposal construction over the MNCS-01 stable candidate core with named, designated, unnamed and unresolved naming dispositions.
Nonhuman and unnamed beings remain first-class: the implementation does not force a human personal-name structure, culture, language, demographic or origin merely to complete a sheet.
Proposal, accepted and unresolved identity facets remain distinct; accepted facets require owner references and unresolved facets cannot carry invented references.

Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form owners retain entity/biology truth, while World/Environment/Settlement/Culture/Language/Demographic owners retain canonical contextual facts; MNCS-04 performs no canonical mutation or automatic proposal acceptance.
